image_additive_uncertainty_audit.scope: Post-result measurement-uncertainty audit; preregistered point-prediction decisions are retained unchanged.
image_additive_uncertainty_audit.hypothesis: True image coordinates obey uv_comb=uv_R+uv_T-uv_base. Each distinct measured coordinate has bounded error epsilon.
image_additive_uncertainty_audit.conditional_derivation: Observed residual has absolute bound epsilon_comb+epsilon_R+epsilon_T+epsilon_base=4epsilon; no independence or Gaussian error assumption.
